name: Broken Dreams
summary: OMORI: BROKEN DREAMS is an OMORI fan sequel loosely based on the mod by Besuki Games. Set after the bad ending, SUNNY manages to tell the truth before he succumbs to OMORI, but what awaits him at the bottom isn't the paradise he's expecting. What will you do now?
